# PatchFerret

> Console show file in, patch paperwork out

Turns a mixing console's show file into paperwork an engineer can actually use: a patch list, a spec sheet and a wiring topology diagram, as PDFs. It runs in the browser or on the command line.

It's a Stoatworks Labs web tool: free, and it runs in a web browser.

## Links

- [PatchFerret, the app](https://patchferret.stoatworks-labs.com/): runs in the browser, free
- [Project page](https://stoatworks-labs.com/software/patchferret/)
- [Web tool page](https://stoatworks-labs.com/web-tools/patchferret/)
- [User guide](https://stoatworks-labs.com/software/patchferret/guide/)
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/stoatworks-labs/patchferret)
- [Self-hosting](https://stoatworks-labs.com/web-tools/self-hosting/): run it on your own server
